items.t: Engine stalls or dies while driving
items.job: Diagnose stalling; software update or electrical repair
items.note: Owners report about $300-$420. If oil burning caused engine damage, see the oil consumption repair.

items.t: Excessive oil consumption
items.job: Oil consumption test; engine or short block replacement if confirmed
items.note: The test itself costs little; engine replacement is the high end and has often been done under the powertrain warranty.

items.t: Automatic transmission stops working or goes into limp mode
items.job: Repair shift linkage or wiring, or replace transmission
items.note: Owners report about $290 for a shift cable and $3,400-$7,000 for a transmission.

items.t: Jerky or rough shifting from the dual-clutch automatic
items.job: Transmission software update or clutch adaptation; clutch pack if worn

items.t: Clutch pedal sticks to the floor (manual)
items.job: Replace clutch master cylinder and line
items.note: Owners report about $500; a full clutch job costs more.

items.t: Turbocharger failure
items.job: Replace turbocharger
items.note: A sensor or wastegate solenoid is far cheaper if that's the cause.

items.t: Engine revs up while stopped with foot on the brake
items.job: Diagnose idle surge; throttle or software repair
items.note: No standard fix; cost depends on what is found.

items.t: Check engine light from misfires and ignition coils
items.job: Replace ignition coil and spark plugs

items.t: Thermostat failure turns on check engine light
items.job: Replace thermostat

items.t: Coolant leak and overheating
items.job: Replace heater hose and refill coolant

items.t: Oil pressure sensor sets check engine light
items.job: Replace oil pressure sensor

items.t: Wipers stay on or won't shut off
items.job: Replace steering column control module (SCCM)

items.t: Uconnect screen goes blank or radio shuts off
items.job: Uconnect software update or radio replacement

items.t: Creaking or squeaking when turning
items.job: Lubricate upper strut mounts

items.t: Sun visor breaks and hangs down
items.job: Replace sun visor

items.t: Steering binds or becomes very heavy
items.job: Diagnose and repair steering column or power steering
items.note: No standard fix reported; cost depends on the part found.

items.t: Shifter cable can come off the transmission (recall)
items.job: Replace shifter cable bushing

items.t: Transmission can shift into neutral (recall)
items.job: Replace transmission control module and bracket

items.t: Oil can damage the brake booster (recall)
items.job: Replace vacuum line; brake booster and pump if contaminated

items.t: Wipers can stop working from washer pump fault (recall)
items.job: Replace windshield washer pump
